# SOMA photography v4: the Profi portraits with more variety

*Photo Art Director · 2 Nov 2026. Generated by `brand/photography/tools/v4-audit.mjs` from `generation/jobs-v4.json`; do not hand-edit. The rest of the set stays v3 (`AUDIT-v3.md`).*

**Why.** The client approved more variety (2 Nov 2026: „mach ruhig mit etwas mehr Abwechslung!“): in v3 all 30 portraits shared one backdrop (shelf and plant), one pose (hands clasped) and one framing, so the series read stock-like.

**How.** Same model (`nano_banana_pro`, 2k) and the v3 „Tageslicht“ light, grade and light wardrobe; **each Profi's v3 portrait is the image reference**, so the faces stay the same people ("keep the face, hair, skin tone, age, build and the same light work outfit; only the setting, the pose and the framing change"). Prompts: `generation/shotlist-v4.mjs`.

| | |
|---|---|
| Credits | **72** of 90 (balance 814.99 → 742.99) |
| Generations | **36** (4 pilot + 26 + 6 retries) |
| Rejected in QA | **6** |
| Final | **30** portraits, all pass |
| Settings (6) | client's living room 5 · office 5 · window with tools 5 · own studio 5 · hotel 5 · doorway arrival 5 |
| Poses (7) | holding a tool or towel 5 · lightly crossed 4 · leaning on a counter 5 · seated 4 · natural laugh 4 · slight three-quarter turn 4 · arms relaxed at the sides 4 |
| Framing | head to waist for most; seated and arms-at-the-sides frames to mid-thigh so the hands stay inside |
| Set dressing | a different plant/furniture combination in every frame; 15 frames without plants |
| Registry | `pros/pro-NN-v4.jpg`, 4:5, 1200 × 1500, own focal point (face column; y 15 %, 10 % for the wider frames); `pro-NN-v3` → `replacedBy` v4. The chain pro-NN → v2 → v3 → v4 is exactly the three hops `src/lib/images.ts` follows: a v5 would need the hop limit raised (code, not done). |

QA: every file at full size; identity checked as v3/v4 face pairs; hands and limbs cropped at 150 %. Wardrobe rule from `PHOTOGRAPHY.md` § 8 (light uniform, never black) applied to the trousers that v4's wider frames now show.
